name: Big-box store (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Generic big-box retailer, 58 x 40 m and 7.5 m tall: ribbed metal cladding on a concrete base, a tall entrance portal with a blank sign band and canopy over a glazed vestibule, skylights and rooftop units. Inside: the vestibule, a customer-service office and a cafe along the front, a 58 x 26 m sales floor with steel columns, shelving gondolas and six checkout lanes, a stockroom behind with three roller doors onto a sunken loading dock (truck well, bumpers, dock shelters, canopy). Brings a cart corral for the car park.
